news.title: India office leasing flat at 66.7 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026; GCC share rises to 41%: Report
news.para: Office leasing across India’s top eight markets stood at 66.7 million sq ft in the first nine months of 2026, broadly unchanged year-on-year. GCC leasing rose 10.4% to 27.4 million sq ft, while new office completions increased 50% to 48.6 million sq ft.

news.title: UP RERA extends QPR filing deadline to October 21; makes DSC-based certificates mandatory
news.para: UP RERA has extended the deadline for filing quarterly progress reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to October 21. Promoters will now have to submit digitally signed REG-1, REG-2 and REG-3 certificates along with the QPR.

news.title: Many vacant plots encroached; Indirapuram residents write to Ghaziabad development body, demand action
news.para: Residents of Indirapuram are raising concerns about the encroachment on plots allotted by Ghaziabad Development Authority. They claim that around 20% of these plots are illegally occupied and affecting community security. The Indirapuram Welfare Association has demanded action from the GDA regarding unauthorized occupations and connections. Residents have requested a six-month notice for plot owners to start construction or face eviction.

news.title: Puravankara to jointly develop 12.76-acre land in Bengaluru
news.para: Puravankara has signed a joint development agreement for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur, North Bengaluru. The proposed residential project has an estimated saleable area of 1.90 million sq ft and potential GDV of ₹2,500 crore.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh CM virtually launches house title distribution in Nellore
news.para: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu officially kicked off the distribution of permanent house titles to 939 families, a significant initiative worth around Rs 600 crore. This follows prior efforts where 60,000 families received titles encompassing properties valued at Rs 52,000 crore. The government is also focused on enhancing essential infrastructure along with housing provisions for low-income families.

news.title: Ensure early approval for Chennai metro rail phase-III: Tamil Nadu CM urges PM
news.para: Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay has called on Prime Minister Narendra Modi to swiftly approve Chennai Metro Rail Phase-3. He pointed out the necessity for connectivity enhancements to areas like Airport-Kilambakkam and Poonamallee-Sunguvarchatram. Additionally, he urged for high-speed rail links to Kanyakumari and Coimbatore to promote regional advancement.

news.title: Bajaj Alts raises ₹950 crore in initial close of maiden commercial real estate fund
news.para: Bajaj Alternate Investment Management has raised about ₹950 crore in the initial close of its maiden real estate fund. The fund has a target corpus of ₹2,000 crore, including a green shoe option, and will invest in commercial office developments through equity joint ventures with developers.

news.title: Eco City-3 clears key hurdle, 716-acre New Chandigarh township set to take shape
news.para: Gmada has secured environmental clearance for the ambitious Eco City-3 project in New Chandigarh, encompassing an area of 716 acres across nine villages in Mullanpur. This initiative aims to introduce a variety of residential and commercial spaces to elevate the housing market in the region. Allotments for plots will be conducted through a draw, while commercial properties will be allocated via public auctions.

news.title: Approved layouts in Bengaluru caught in PRR2 acquisition net
news.para: Homeowners at Gardens 4 and Sri Krishna Gardens near Kaggalipura are facing troubling conditions as the state government has ordered the acquisition of their lands for the Peripheral Ring Road 2. After buying their sites with government approval, residents are now in distress over potential losses. They are advocating for a reconsideration of this order, as their dreams of home construction hang in the balance.

news.title: BNP Paribas leases five lakh sq ft office in Mindspace REIT’s Chennai complex
news.para: BNP Paribas has signed a long-term lease for around half a million square feet in Chennai. The deal spans four floors within the One Radial commercial complex and is among the largest in the city this year. Office rentals in this area are approximately Rs 90 per square foot per month. Chennai is increasingly appealing to multinational companies due to lower operating costs and a skilled talent pool.

news.title: Revised Sports City plan approved, Noida authority tells Supreme court
news.para: After a Supreme Court directive revoked previous development bans, the Noida Authority has secured approval for a modified layout of the 300-acre Sports City initiative. The new plan designates 70% of the land for sports amenities, responding to community feedback. Additionally, occupancy certificates for various housing projects have been issued, with upcoming hearings on other developments expected in December and January.

news.title: Maharashtra: Panel formed to review SRA discusses ways to make redevelopment process more effective
news.para: An 11-member committee has been established to conduct a performance audit of the Maharashtra Slum Areas Act. This committee, formed following a Bombay High Court directive, aims to expedite the redevelopment process. Additionally, it will gather input from various stakeholders, including developers and landowners. The committee is set to submit its findings and recommendations within a 10-month period.

news.title: Rustomjee Group explores senior living foray; sees scope for over 5,000 homes in MMR
news.para: Rustomjee Group is evaluating an entry into senior living and is open to developing projects independently or with a partner, chairman and managing director Boman Irani said. While the investment and development structure are yet to be finalised, he estimates that Mumbai Metropolitan Region can support more than 5,000 senior living homes.

news.title: Siddha Group targets ₹1,894 crore turnover by FY30; plans listing by March 2028
news.para: Siddha Group expects its turnover to increase 42% to ₹852 crore in FY27 from ₹600 crore in FY26 and reach ₹1,894 crore by FY30. The developer has estimated construction expenditure of ₹1,063 crore for three upcoming Mumbai projects and plans to become a listed entity by March 2028 through an internal restructuring exercise.

news.title: Bombay HC quashes stamp duty demands on Goregaon property transactions
news.para: The Bombay High Court has quashed stamp duty demands on property transactions in Goregaon that involved multiple agreements. Authorities initially treated the 2012 conveyances as new transactions instead of finalizing earlier agreements from 1985. The Court emphasized the importance of analyzing the entire chain of documents to understand the transactions. It ruled that the final conveyances only completed previous arrangements rather than initiating new sales.

news.title: No RR rate hike, higher target, yet Maharashtra stamp duty collections near 50% of annual goal
news.para: In a remarkable display of economic activity, Pune's registration and stamps department is nearing half its annual revenue goal before Dasara, boasting figures of Rs33,387 crore as of October 8. This surge stems from a bustling real estate market, where more than 26 lakh documents were processed from April to September.

news.title: New Town Kolkata development body flags 38 buildings for illegal commercial use
news.para: The New Town Kolkata Development Authority has flagged unauthorized commercial endeavors in 38 residential buildings. Inspections revealed that several owners neglected to secure permissions for commercial use, which should not exceed 40% of the buildings' total area. Additionally, numerous units were operating without necessary fire licenses, posing significant safety risks. Authorities stress the importance of obtaining prior approval for any commercial activities.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh cabinet approves release of ₹115 crore as first instalment for urban expansion
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved the release of Rs 115 crore for development projects in Mirzapur-Vindhyachal and Muzaffarnagar. This funding is part of a larger budget of Rs 3,500 crore allocated for comprehensive urban development in the 2026-27 financial year. Additionally, the Cabinet has approved plans to widen and strengthen State Highway number 84 in Mainpuri district.

news.title: CET begins inspection of Vizhinjam flats amid concerns over structural defects
news.para: The College of Engineering Trivandrum has begun an investigation into the residential flats constructed for fishermen near the Vizhinjam harbour. Residents have raised significant concerns regarding deteriorating plaster and damaged ceilings, prompting discussions around safety. Mayor V V Rajesh has expressed his apprehensions about possible construction irregularities. The local corporation will conduct a technical assessment to uncover and address the reported deficiencies.

news.title: Telangana HC quashes Tellapur land acquisition, relief for plot owners
news.para: The Telangana high court has annulled land acquisition proceedings for Tellapur that began almost twenty years ago. The court determined that the acquisition lacked purpose clarity, which hindered landowners' ability to raise meaningful objections. The authorities must strictly adhere to legal protocols for any future acquisitions. Additionally, deficiencies in the Section 5-A inquiry under the Land Acquisition Act were noted, offering significant relief to many affected homeowners in Tellapur.
